name: Ogryn Role
summary: Role Benefit Bulwark While using a shield, allies behind you gain light cover. Gun Lugger You can use heavy weapons without the normal movement penalty. Bone ’ead You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves and one additional skill. Brute Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 damage.
